name: browser-use
headline: Prose - AI Automation Language
short_description: Prose is a programming language for long-running AI sessions, enabling Turing-complete computation. It allows operations teams to automate complex workflows, integrate with various tools, and build custom applications. Ideal for developers and operations professionals.
author: openprose

sections.overview:
Prose is a programming language designed to enable long-running AI sessions with Turing-complete computation capabilities. It allows operations teams and developers to automate complex workflows, integrate with various tools, and build custom applications by declaring required skills and leveraging AI agent harnesses. Prose components can declare dependencies through a Skills section with fail-closed compile resolution, ensuring all required harness skills are available before execution. The language supports multiple skill search paths and resolves skills against local and global directories, making it flexible for both individual developers and enterprise automation teams. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agent platforms through standardized plugin manifests.
Automate research tasks by querying multiple sources and compiling findings into a structured report.
Streamline content creation by integrating AI writing agents that refine drafts based on research data.
Facilitate competitive analysis by running parallel sessions that gather and analyze market data.
Implement error handling and retry mechanisms in workflows to ensure robustness in automation tasks.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/openprose/prose`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
